top_stories.title: Stand-off over Bengaluru Development portfolio likely to be discussed in Delhi - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Krishna Byre Gowda**, Karnataka's Minister for Bengaluru Development, is reportedly dissatisfied with the truncated portfolio he received.  He has expressed his discontent to **Congress Central leadership**, amidst a critical monsoon season and an absence of elected councillors in Bengaluru due to delayed elections for five corporations under the Greater Bengaluru Authority (GBA).

top_stories.title: Watch: Judge Strikes Down Trump’s H-1B Fee: Implications for India and the U.S. | Above the Fold | 09.06.2026 - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **The Hindu** published a news summary on June 9, 2026, covering various current events. The program featured updates on a major U.S. court setback, Donald Trump's H-1B visa fee plan, escalating political turmoil in West Bengal, and developments in the CMRL case involving T Veena.  The news summary was presented by **Sonikka Loganathan** as the programme lead, with **Naveenkumar V** and **Karthi P** handling the shoot and edit respectively.

top_stories.title: Do not want confrontation with Governor, but cannot compromise on State’s rights, says Tamil Nadu Higher Education Minister - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Higher Education Minister P. Viswanathan** stated that the government would not compromise on its autonomy in appointing Vice-Chancellors of state universities, despite a potential confrontation with **Governor**. He emphasized the importance of cooperation between the Governor and the Chief Minister for the smooth functioning of universities, drawing an analogy to the need for equal size wheels on a vehicle.

top_stories.title: Seven killed in blast at ‘illegal’ firecracker warehouse in Jaipur - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: A fire, sparked by a blast at an alleged illegal firecracker warehouse in Jaipur's Khoh Nagoriyan area on Tuesday, resulted in the deaths of seven people and injuries to several others.  **Sawai Man Singh Government Hospital** received six victims, with one succumbing to their injuries during treatment, while the remaining died after being rushed there.

top_stories.title: Court orders restitution of assets worth ₹9,420.57 crore to Justice Lodha Committee in PACL case - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: A special court has ordered the return of 282 immovable properties, valued at approximately ₹9,420.57 crore, attached by the **Enforcement Directorate (ED)** in the PACL Limited case to the **Justice Lodha Committee** for distribution to investors who were cheated. The **ED** has so far attached assets worth close to ₹28,626 crore in India and Australia, held in the names of **PACL Limited**, its group/associate entities, and family members/associates of the late Nirmal Singh Bhangoo.

top_stories.title: Foreign leaders congratulate Modi on becoming longest-serving elected PM of India - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** has received congratulatory messages from **Sri Lankan President Anura Kumara Dissanayake**, **Papua New Guinea's** leader, and **Trinidad and Tobago's** leader. The leaders praised his "transformative governance," advocacy for the Global South, and vision of an inclusive India.

top_stories.title: Issue certified copies of Udhayanidhi Stalin’s nomination papers to defeated candidate, Madras High Court directs ECI - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: The **Madras High Court** ordered the Chennai district election officer to provide certified copies of Udhayanidhi Stalin's accepted and rejected nomination papers and affidavits. The order came after a writ petition filed by P. Milany, who lost the Chepauk-Thiruvallikeni constituency election to Mr. Udhayanidhi Stalin, was allowed.  The court granted this request before the results were officially declared on May 4th, 2026.

top_stories.title: Tamil Nadu Assembly Speaker J.C.D. Prabhakar’s decision marks a throwback to the experience of 11 AIADMK MLAs in 2017-18 - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **J.C.D. Prabhakar**, the Tamil Nadu Assembly Speaker, has chosen not to pursue disqualification proceedings against 21 AIADMK legislators, a decision reminiscent of an eight-year-old incident where 11 MLAs faced similar scrutiny but were spared by then-Speaker **P. Dhanapal**.  Unlike that instance, no formal announcement was made and the matter ultimately went to the Madras High Court, which dismissed a plea for action against the legislators.

top_stories.title: Rebel TMC MPs siding with BJP, says Kalyan Banerjee - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: Following a rebellion by 20 Trinamool Congress Lok Sabha members, loyalists of **Mamata Banerjee** held a press conference in New Delhi, accusing the rebel MPs of siding with the Bharatiya Janata Party.  **Kalyan Banerjee**, Chief Whip of the party in the Lok Sabha, and **Kirti Azad** addressed the media, questioning the authenticity of the letter by the rebels stating they were creating a separate bloc within the Trinamool Congress to support the BJP-led NDA government. They also criticized the rebel MPs for lacking political morality and abandoning party workers.  Several loyalists of **Mamata Banerjee** expressed their disapproval of the CID search at her residence, questioning its purpose and accusing the rebels of targeting party leaders with the help of the BJP.

top_stories.title: Man held for attempting to steal cash from ATM near Katpadi - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **S. Varadarajan**, a 53-year-old man from Bengaluru, was arrested by **Katpadi police** in Vellore for allegedly attempting to steal cash from an ATM at a public sector bank.  He had been unemployed and loitering along the rail route for several weeks before targeting the ATM near farmers' market in Katpadi. He attempted to break into the machine but failed, prompting bank officials to alert the police who subsequently apprehended him. The police seized various items including mobile phones, welding machines, and fake ATM cards.
